    <h1>Final Fantasy XIV setup</h1>

<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
The Final Fantasy XIV module brings Savage, Ultimate and Alliance sign-ups by job, characters with their World, static nights and loot for your Free Company. Finish [**Setting up Alagos**](/guides/setting-up/) first.

## 1. Switch it on

Run `/guild-settings modules` and press **Switch on** beside **Final Fantasy XIV**. Its tab appears in `/guild-settings show`. Alagos calls your group a **Free Company**; rename it with **✏️ What we're called** on the Overview tab (to Static, say).

## 2. Characters and jobs

In FFXIV one character plays every job, so a character has no class. Your members add their own: the name, the **World**, a **main job**, a **second job**, and the **jobs they play** (a list). Officers can add or fix anyone's.

## 3. Roles

A party fills **Tank**, **Pure healer** (White Mage, Astrologian), **Barrier healer** (Scholar, Sage), **Melee**, **Ranged** (Bard, Machinist, Dancer) and **Caster**. A member presses a role and Alagos signs them up with their main job if it plays it, else their second job, else another job on their list. On an event with one Healer or one DPS role, both healer kinds fill Healer and every damage job fills DPS.

## 4. Templates

Press **New event** and pick one by name:

- **Savage night**, **Ultimate prog**, **Extreme trial** (8): 2 tanks, a pure and a barrier healer, 2 melee, 1 ranged, 1 caster. **Start from** also offers a party with any 4 damage.
- **Alliance raid** (24), **Deep Dungeon** (4), **Treasure maps** (8).

Change the slots on any event for your static.

## 5. Coming from Raid-Helper

**📥 Import from Raid-Helper** on the **Features & limits** tab takes Raid-Helper's FFXIV events: each sign-up comes in with its job and role (a White Mage as a pure healer, Magical as Caster). Blue Mage comes in with its role and no job.

## 6. Evercold

**Evercold** (February 23, 2027) brings Bastion and Zephyr: they are added to the job list when it launches.
